result.title: Correcting CondOT: Exact Finite-Step Sampling in Gaussian Flow Matching
result.summary: Flow matching generates samples by gradually transforming noise into data. In practice, using a finite number of sampling steps introduces a numerical error that depends on the chosen schedule. We study this dependence for Gaussian targets and the explicit midpoint sampling method, using the exact flow field. We measure sampling error by the squared Wasserstein distance between the target distribution and the final distribution produced by the midpoint sampler. We show that the standard conditional optimal transport (CondOT) schedule cancels the leading midpoint error and improves the general convergence bound, even when the sampling steps are unequally spaced. On a uniform grid of $S$ sampling steps, we fix the signal schedule at $α_t=t$ and prove the existence of scalar noise schedules $β_t$ that approach the CondOT noise schedule $1-t$ at rate $1/S$ and yield exact Gaussian sampling for every sufficiently large $S$. Controlled Gaussian experiments illustrate the convergence rates and exact calibration.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文研究 Gaussian 目标下 flow matching 的有限步采样误差，用目标分布与显式中点采样器输出分布间的平方 Wasserstein 距离作为度量，分析采样调度对误差的影响，并给出能使高斯采样精确成立的一类噪声调度及其与 CondOT 调度的接近速率。
AI.relevance_reason: 调度与离散步数误差的分析可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理的步数—精度权衡、计算停止决策以及并行/迭代状态更新的误差控制提供可核查的理论类比，但该工作本身不涉及视觉或多模态推理。
